Subject: CloudMed MAP: evaluation runway & hosting mode lock (hosted vs dedicated vs private)

Sara —

Thanks again for the call today. Per our conversation I attached a concise mutual action plan (MAP) draft that lays out the evaluation runway and the decision points for hosting mode and region. High-level ask from CloudMed: confirm whether you want us to prioritize Hosted (fastest to prod), Dedicated (reserved capacity + isolation), or Private (VPC/on-prem) for the POC and what regulatory constraints drive the choice.

Key milestones in the MAP (proposed):
- Week 1: POC kickoff, provide test dataset and examples
- Week 2: Performance baseline (latency / cost) across Hosted vs Dedicated in us-east/us-west
- Week 3: Security gating (SOC2 artifacts, KMS plan) + compliance checklist
- Week 4: Final decision & procurement steps (quote, PO, docs)

Open items we flagged:
- If you need customer-managed keys or an air-gapped option, that pushes us toward Private and adds ~4 weeks for infra prep.
- Dedicated requires a monthly commit; we can provide a 60-day test reservation for evaluation economics.

Please review the attached MAP_v2 (spreadsheet) and call out any timing constraints. If you want, we can run a short perf comparison (same model + quantization profile) on both Hosted and Dedicated in us-east to show tradeoffs — that usually helps execs make the decision.

Next step: a quick alignment session tomorrow (30 mins) to lock the mode so procurement can draft the final quote. Are you available 9:00–11:00 PT?

Best,
Neha Kapoor

Neha —

Thanks, that MAP looks solid and clear. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Compliance baseline: CloudMed is operating under HIPAA + state privacy regs. We will need either Redwood-hosted data isolation with signed BAAs (we have a template) or a Dedicated/Private option with customer-managed keys. Can you confirm which of those is available for the POC?

2) Timeline pressure: Our internal audit is scheduled for the week of Aug 2; ideally we have the POC complete and a decision in the week prior. That shortens your proposed 4-week runway by one week.

3) Procurement: Procurement prefers a single quote for the POC that shows (a) Hosted cost baseline, (b) Dedicated 60-day trial cost, and (c) a rough ballpark for Private (assuming customer-managed KMS). They asked for a DocuSign-friendly quote.

We are available for the alignment session tomorrow at 10:00 PT. 

Thanks — I will also loop my security lead if we get into KMS/airgap detail.

Sara Johnson
Director, Product Ops | CloudMed Health

Sara / Procurement team —

Appreciate the alignment today. Per the MAP and the perf numbers Karthik shared on the call, CloudMed has decided to proceed with a two-stage path:

1) POC (2 weeks): Hosted environment in us-east as the primary evaluation lane. This allows us to validate latency & accuracy quickly and aligns with your audit window. Redwood will enable tenant isolation + signed BAA.

2) Parallel Dedicated trial (60 days): We will reserve a Dedicated pool (us-east) that mirrors the production workload. If the POC metrics meet the thresholds in the MAP, we will convert the Dedicated trial to a committed monthly pool.

Notes and constraints:
- Private (VPC/on-prem) is scoped out for now due to time constraints; CloudMed retains the option to revisit for long-term requirements.
- For HIPAA: Attached is our SOC2 summary and the BAA template for your legal. We will sign an addendum to include KMS options if you later require customer-managed keys.

Attached: final MAP (CloudMed_MAP_v2.xlsx), SOC2_summary.pdf, DocuSign_Quote_CloudMed.pdf (quote includes Hosted POC line, Dedicated 60-day trial line, and Private rough-estimate).

Next steps (actions we've committed to):
- Redwood (Karthik / Marissa): Send final DocuSign quote by EOD tomorrow (Jul 20).
- CloudMed (Procurement): Return signed quote/PO or request redline by Jul 26 so we can meet your audit window.
- Redwood Legal & CloudMed Legal: exchange BAA redline no later than Jul 23.

If that timeline looks good, we will kick off onboarding on Jul 22 and start the Hosted POC the same day.

Best,
